_comment: smtp-proxy-rs uses the GENERATED repo-infra standard: ci.yml, changelog.yml,
and build/man.mk plus build/man-deflist.lua all come out of the assembler.
Do not hand-edit them; take the newer set instead, or the next `apply`
The ONE deliberate exception is the publish-deb-container job in
release-publish.yml. It is declared under publish_local below, so the
assembler generates finalize's `needs:` and asset check for it; the job
body itself is hand-owned and must survive every merge `apply` asks for.
